title: Training Institute Franchise Opportunity
name: IPCS Global, 33 Franchisees, Est'd in 2008, Kochi HQ
description: About IPCS Global: IPCS Global is a technology-focused training and solutions organization established in 2008 in Kochi, Kerala. The company initially began its operations in industrial automation projects and subsequently expanded into technical education and professional skill development. Today, IPCS Global offers industry-oriented training, corporate training, technical solutions, and placement support across a diverse range of technology domains, including: - Industrial automation: PLC, SCADA, DCS, HMI, VFD, and control panel design. - BMS & CCTV: building management, security, and fire systems. - Embedded systems & IoT. - Artificial intelligence. - Python & data science. - Digital marketing. - Software testing. - Corporate & in-campus training. IPCS Global currently operates 33 offline training centres through a combination of Company-Owned Company-Operated (COCO) and Franchise-Owned Franchise-Operated (FOFO) models. The organization has an active student base of approximately 5,000 students across its online and offline platforms. The company has the necessary Incorporation and GST registrations in place. A key strength of IPCS Global is its practical, industry-oriented training approach, which combines hands-on learning, real-time projects, experienced trainers, industry certifications, and placement assistance. This model enables students and professionals to develop relevant technical skills aligned with industry requirements.
